dryRun.description: Count only, and report what would change.

status.description: The existing job's status, when alreadyQueued is true.

alreadyQueued.description: True when a refresh was already pending or running; jobId is that job, and nothing new was queued.

main.description: Queue a job that recounts how many games each organization is credited as publishing. Search uses the counts to tell established publishers from fan teams. Admins only. One refresh runs at a time.
